messages.content: 一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.content:
**熵變化計算（1 kg 冰 → 100 °C 蒸汽，1 atm）** | 階段 | 熱力學參數 | 計算式 | 結果 | |------|------------|--------|------| | **融化**（0 °C → 0 °C） | 潛熱 \(L_f = 334\,\text{kJ/kg}\)，熔點 \(T_m = 273.15\,\text{K}\) | \(\displaystyle \Delta S_{\text{fus}} = \frac{L_f}{T_m}\) | \(\displaystyle \frac{334\,000}{273.15}=1\,223\,\text{J/(kg·K)}\) | | **升溫水**（0 °C → 100 °C） | 比熱 \(c_{p,w}=4.18\,\text{kJ/(kg·K)}\) | \(\displaystyle \Delta S_{\text{heat}} = c_{p,w}\,\ln\!\left(\frac{T_f}{T_i}\right)\)
\(T_i=273.15\,\text{K},\;T_f=373.15\,\text{K}\) | \(\displaystyle 4.18\times10^3 \times \ln\!\left(\frac{373.15}{273.15}\right)=1\,305\,\text{J/(kg·K)}\) | | **蒸發**（100 °C → 100 °C） | 潛熱 \(L_v = 2257\,\text{kJ/kg}\)，沸點 \(T_b = 373.15\,\text{K}\) | \(\displaystyle \Delta S_{\text{vap}} = \frac{L_v}{T_b}\) | \(\displaystyle \frac{2\,257\,000}{373.15}=6\,050\,\text{J/(kg·K)}\) | --- ### 總熵變化 \[ \begin{aligned} \Delta S_{\text{total}} &= m\bigl(\Delta S_{\text{fus}}+\Delta S_{\text{heat}}+\Delta S_{\text{vap}}\bigr)\\[4pt] &= 1\,\text{kg}\;\bigl(1\,223+1\,305+6\,050\bigr)\,\text{J/(kg·K)}\\[4pt] &= 8\,578\,\text{J/K}\;\approx\;8.58\times10^{3}\,\text{J/K}. \end{aligned} \] --- #### 結論 在 1 atm 下，將 1 kg 的冰從 0 °C 加熱至 100 °C（最終為 100 °C 蒸汽）的熵變化約為 **\(8.6\times10^{3}\,\text{J/K}\)**。如果你只想得到熵變化值，直接使用上述公式即可；若需要更精確的數值，可根據實際測量的比熱和潛熱進行微調。

Use standard values: latent heat of fusion L_f = 334 kJ/kg, latent heat of vaporization L_v = 2257 kJ/kg. Specific heat capacities: c_p_ice ~2.09 kJ/(kg·K), c_p_water ~4.18 kJ/(kg·K). For steam at 100°C, c_p_gas ~2.01 kJ/(kg·K). But we only need entropy change, not final temperature integration for gas? Actually we need to integrate from 0°C to 100°C for water. For steam, no further heating. So ΔS_total = m*(L_f/Tm + ∫_{273.15}^{373.15} c_p_water/T dT + L_v/Tb). Where Tm=273.15 K, Tb=373.15 K.

Compute integral: ∫ c_p_water/T dT = c_p_water * ln(T_final/T_initial). c_p_water constant ~4.18 kJ/(kg·K). So integral = 4.18*ln(373.15/273.15)=4.18*ln(1.366)=4.18*0.312=1.305 kJ/K per kg. Convert to J/K: multiply by 1000 => 1305 J/K.

Now L_f/Tm = 334000 J/kg / 273.15 K = 1223 J/K per kg. L_v/Tb = 2257000 J/kg / 373.15 K = 6050 J/K per kg. Sum: 1223+1305+6050=8578 J/K per kg. Multiply by 1 kg => 8578 J/K. So answer ~8580 J/K. Provide explanation.
